summary: KfW, the German state development bank, priced a $3.0bn 4.50% Global Notes offering due October 10, 2031, via a Rule 424(b)(5) pricing supplement to its June 26, 2026 shelf. Notes priced at 99.480 for a 99.355 proceeds rate, with 0.125% underwriting commissions across CIBC, Goldman Sachs Bank Europe, J.P. Morgan and Morgan Stanley; settlement is expected September 16, 2026. The notes carry a statutory Federal Republic of Germany guarantee, are non-redeemable pre-maturity, and carry no tax gross-up. Listing targets the Luxembourg Stock Exchange regulated market. This is a routine benchmark funding takedown, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle.
